tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Find hotels and private stays by plain words, with optional filters for country, destination, collection, amenities, and a nightly budget in euros. Best matches first. Gives each stay's page URL, place, short description, and "from" rate.

tools.name: get_stay
tools.description: One stay as its page shows it: description, address, location, website, "from" rate, amenities, collections, and photo URLs.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: The countries and destinations that have stays, and the collections (Coast, City, Mountain…), each with its number of stays. Their names and slugs are the filters of search_stays.

tools.name: get_destination
tools.description: One destination and its stays: the first 10 and the total, or all of them with detail "full".

tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: The travel writing, newest first: title, standfirst, author, category, date, and page URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One article: its opening paragraphs, or with detail "full" its whole text with every list of places.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: The city guides on sale: city, standfirst, price, and the URL of the page where a reader can buy the guide.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One city guide's public shop page: its standfirst, what it holds, its price, and photo URLs. The guide itself is sold on its page.

tools.name: buy_guide
tools.description: Buy a city guide for the user, paid inside this conversation. Gives a pay link that takes an MPP payment (a Stripe Shared Payment Token from your wallet, such as Link). Confirm the user's email first: the guide goes to that account, and the purchase is final.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_stays, get_stay, list_articles, list_guides, get_guide · Private data: search_stays, buy_guide · Public sink: buy_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_stays, get_stay, list_articles, list_guides, get_guide · Private data: search_stays, buy_guide · Public sink: buy_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
